body.message: Hello Billy, We have received your bank details for the deposit refund. However, we would like to confirm the account holder's name, as the booking is registered under the name  Katie Louise Williams , while the bank account details provided are under a different name. Could you please confirm whether we should proceed with processing the deposit refund using the bank details you have shared? Thank you, and we look forward to your confirmation. Kind regards, Chahana T.
